[[Message from a Friend]] serves as the very first [[quest]] for newly created characters in [[Guild Wars Prophecies]]. It is a simple breadcrumb trail designed to lead players to the [[Primary quest|primary quest line]] of [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)|pre-Searing Ascalon]]. The [[Town Crier]] has a message for you: [[Sir Tydus]] is looking for you and bears good news.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| test = n
}}
* [[War Preparations]] not completed

===Objectives===
* Go to the town square in [[Ascalon City (pre-Searing)|Ascalon City]]. Talk to Sir Tydus.

===Reward===
* 100 [[Experience]]
* 10 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Head north from the Town Crier, crossing the stone bridge. You will find Sir Tydus on a podium just in front of the gate to the [[Ascalon Academy]]. Speak to him to claim your reward and learn of his news.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Town Crier
:''"Excuse me, you're <Character name>, aren't you? I think '''Sir Tydus''' was looking for you. He said he had some good news for you."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I like good news.
| decline = Leave me be.
| ask = I'm certain '''Sir Tydus''' is around here somewhere. He seemed anxious to talk to you.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Sir Tydus
:''"There you are, my friend. I am glad you are here. I have news that I think you'll appreciate."''

==Notes==
* While it acts as an introduction to the questing system, this quest is entirely optional. You can proceed directly to Sir Tydus to begin [[War Preparations]].  The only thing you will miss is a small amount of gold and experience.
